重新下载当前需要的规则集: Downloads the rule-sets in use again
基于 NekoBox / sing-box 的代理客户端: A proxy client based on NekoBox / sing-box
没有可以打开链接的应用: No app can open the link
与 GitHub Releases 上的最新版本比对: Compares with the latest version on GitHub Releases
打开 App 时检查，有新版本会提醒: Checks when the app opens and tells you about a new version
密码不对，或者文件已损坏: Wrong password, or the file is damaged

%s 连不上，已换到 %s（%d ms）: %s did not answer, switched to %s (%d ms)
没有找到可以导入的节点或订阅: Found no node or subscription to import

这是订阅还是 HTTP 代理？: A subscription or an HTTP proxy?

搜索应用名或包名: Search by app or package name

在首页选「指定应用」后生效。: Takes effect after choosing "Selected apps" on the home page.
按节点名称识别地区，例如「东京」「JP」和国旗。: The region is read from node names, such as "Tokyo", "JP" or a flag.
节点名称包含任意一个就算，用空格隔开: Nodes whose name contains any of them; separate with spaces
在下面的列表里点一个节点。: Tap a node in the list below.
连接后每 10 分钟测一次，自动用延迟最低的节点。: While connected the nodes are tested every 10 minutes and the fastest one is used.
有 %d 条规则或场景用到它，删除后改走首页选中的节点。: %d rules or scenes use it; after deleting they use the node selected on the home page.
首页选中的节点: The node selected on the home page
包名格式不对，例如 com.example.app: Not a package name, e.g. com.example.app
用正则表达式匹配域名: Matches domains with a regular expression
连接时当前节点不通，就换成同组里最快的可用节点。默认关闭: When the selected node does not answer on connecting, switch to the fastest working node of its group. Off by default
超过这个时间算连不上: A node slower than this counts as down
每 5 分钟检查一次，只在亮屏时；连续两次不通才换: Checked every 5 minutes with the screen on; switches after two failures in a row
先确认手机能上网，再测当前节点: Check that the phone is online, then test the selected node
不通就同时测同组其他节点: If it does not answer, test the other nodes of its group at once
连到最快的可用节点；一个都不通就不连接，并说明原因: Connect to the fastest working node; if none works, do not connect and say why
测试使用「测速」里的测试地址，结果会更新到节点列表。: Tests use the URL from "Latency test" and update the node list.
TCP 测试只测到服务器的握手时间，更快但不代表节点可用。Hysteria2、T: The TCP test only times the handshake with the server: faster, but it does not prove the node works. UDP protocols such as Hysteria2 and TUIC, and chain proxies, still use the URL test.
只在你自己打开 App 时: Only when you open the app yourself
当前节点连不上时换一个能用的: Use a working node when the selected one is down
只代理或排除选中的应用: Proxy or exclude the selected apps
带 ShadowTLS 的节点没有通用的分享链接格式: Nodes with ShadowTLS have no common share link format
链式代理请在链式代理编辑页修改: Edit chain proxies in the chain proxy editor
链式代理只能用 URL 测试: Chain proxies can only be URL tested
这是 Windows 版本机加密保存的 profiles.json，不是备份文件: This is a profiles.json encrypted for one Windows account, not a backup: make a backup with "Export" on the computer
点一条连接，可以把它的网站或应用加进分流规则。: Tap a connection to add its website or app to the routing rules.
想看到每个连接来自哪个应用，可以在「设置 → 高级」里打开「显示连接所属应用」。: To see which app made each connection, turn on "Show the app of each connection" in Settings → Advanced.
流量从上往下依次经过这些节点，网站看到的是最后一个节点的 IP。需要 2 到 8: Traffic passes these nodes from top to bottom; websites see the IP of the last one. 2 to 8 nodes; drag the handle on the right to change the order.
按住右边的把手上下拖。更新订阅后会保持你排好的顺序，新节点排在最后。: Drag the handle on the right up or down. Subscription updates keep your order; new nodes go to the end.
流量依次经过几个节点，网站看到最后一个节点的 IP: Traffic passes several nodes in a row; websites see the last node's IP
输入一个网址（比如 chatgpt.com）或 IP，看看它会在哪一步被接住、从: Type a website (e.g. chatgpt.com) or an IP to see which step catches it and where it goes. You can also pick the app making the connection.
在广告域名列表里，第一步就被拦下。: It is on the ad domain list and is stopped at the first step.
这是局域网地址（比如家里的路由器），总是直连。: This is a local network address (your router, for example), always direct.
你的规则里都没有它；它是国内网站或国内 IP，被「绕过中国大陆」接住。: None of your rules match it; it is a mainland China website or IP and "Bypass mainland China" catches it.
现在是全部直连。: Everything goes direct at the moment.
前面每一步都没匹配到，走首页选中的节点。: No step above matched, so it uses the node selected on the home page.
这个应用的所有连接都按这条走，不看网址。: Every connection of this app follows this rule, whatever the website.
想换个走法？加一条规则: Route it differently? Add a rule
请选择常用服务，或者输入域名: Pick a common service or type a domain
请输入 IP 地址或 IP 段，例如 10.0.0.0/8: Type an IP address or range, e.g. 10.0.0.0/8
点一下加入整组域名: One tap adds all their domains
或者输入域名，一行一个: Or type domains, one per line
example.com 也会匹配 www.example.com、api.exa: example.com also matches www.example.com and api.example.com
找不到？手动输入包名: Not listed? Type the package name
IP 地址或 IP 段，一行一个: IP addresses or ranges, one per line
没安装的应用也可以先加上: Apps that are not installed can be added too
这个网站走代理: Send this website through the proxy
这个网站走分组代理…: Send this website to a policy group…
%s 整个应用走代理: Send all of %s through the proxy
%s 整个应用走分组代理…: Send all of %s to a policy group…
排除的应用不进 VPN，直接用手机网络: Excluded apps skip the VPN and use the phone's network
其他应用不进 VPN，直接用手机网络: Other apps skip the VPN and use the phone's network
全部直连时不生效: Not used while everything goes direct
还没有规则，点这里添加: No rules yet, tap to add
从上往下依次判断，在哪一步匹配到就从那一步出去。同一个网站同时写在几处时，更具体: Steps are checked from the top; a connection leaves at the first step that matches. When a website appears in several places, the more specific domain wins.
这些不经过节点，直接连接。点一条可以修改、移到别的页或删除。: These connect directly, not through a node. Tap one to change, move or delete it.
这些连接会被拦下。点一条可以修改、移到别的页或删除。: These connections are blocked. Tap one to change, move or delete it.
开着「绕过中国大陆」或只代理部分应用时，这些也一定走代理；可以指定用哪个分组代理: These always use the proxy, even with "Bypass mainland China" on or only some apps proxied; you can pick a policy group for them.
分组代理是一组节点（比如所有日本节点），可以自动选最快的，也可以手动选一个。: A policy group is a set of nodes (all Japanese nodes, say); it can use the fastest one or the one you choose.
还没有规则。点右下角「添加」，可以加网站、应用或 IP。: No rules yet. Tap "Add" at the bottom right to add websites, apps or IPs.
保留在列表里，但不生效: Stays in the list but has no effect
备份文件用密码加密。手机版和 NextBox for Windows 导出的备份: Backups are sealed with a password. Backups from this app and from NextBox for Windows can be imported by either.
忘记密码就没法恢复，请记好。: Without the password the backup cannot be restored; keep it safe.
手机版或 Windows 版导出的文件，也支持 profiles.json: A file exported by NextBox for Android or Windows, or a profiles.json

这些规则集还没下载，暂时没法判断：%s。连接一次后会自动下载。: These rule-sets are not downloaded yet, so they could not be checked: %s. They are downloaded on the next connection.

电脑上打开的场景（%s）会变成对应的规则，放在原来的位置。: The scenes switched on on the computer (%s) become the matching rules, in the same place.
全部直连的选择、端口、TUN 等这台手机的设置不会被覆盖。: This phone's own settings (all direct or not, port, TUN) stay as they are.
现有的分组、节点和分组代理会被替换。: The current groups, nodes and policy groups are replaced.
按点选的顺序加入: Added in the order you tick them
找到 %d 个重复节点：服务器、端口、密码等连接参数完全一样，只是名字不同。每组: Found %d duplicate nodes: server, port, password and the other connection settings are the same, only the names differ. One of each set is kept, the others are deleted.
打开后切换到规则分流: Turning it on switches to rule-based routing
国内网站和 IP 直连: Websites and IPs in China go direct
手机上所有应用都经过 VPN，按路由模式和分流规则决定走代理还是直连。下面选好的: Every app on the phone goes through the VPN; the routing mode and rules decide what is proxied. The apps selected below are kept and used when you switch.
选中的应用直接联网，其余应用都走 VPN；以后新装的应用也走 VPN。适合排除银: The selected apps connect directly, every other app goes through the VPN, including apps installed later. Useful for banking and payment apps.

在广告域名列表里，被「屏蔽广告」拦下。: It is on the ad domain list and is blocked by "Block ads".

把域名、IP、应用、网站分类等放进同一个规则集，它们命中后都走同一个去向。活动页: Put domains, IPs, apps, site categories and more into one rule set; whatever matches goes to the same target. The activity page shows the name of the rule set a connection matched. Separate several values with new lines, commas or spaces.
不写类型时：网址是规则集网址，IP 是 IP 段，其余当作域名: Without a type: addresses are rule-set URLs, IPs are IP ranges, the rest are domains
只支持 sing-box 的 .srs 或 .json 规则集，Clash 规则: Only sing-box .srs or .json rule-sets; Clash rules are not compatible. Downloaded when connecting and again with "Update rule-sets".
电脑程序 %d 个，只在 Windows 版生效，会原样保留。: %d desktop programs: only used by NextBox for Windows, kept as they are.
从上往下依次判断，在哪一步命中就从哪一步出去。按住左边的把手拖动，调整先后顺序。: Checked from top to bottom; a connection leaves at the first step that matches. Drag the handle on the left to change the order.
关闭的屏蔽广告和常用场景不显示: Ad blocking and scenes that are off are not shown
每行一条规则，适合一次改很多条: One rule per line, handy for many changes at once
会删除你添加的所有规则和规则集，常用场景和步骤顺序恢复成刚安装时的样子（只开启「: Deletes all your rules and rule sets; the scenes and the order of the steps go back to how they were after installing (only "Bypass mainland China" on). The routing mode, ad blocking and policy groups stay.
修改会自动保存。类型：geosite、suffix（域名）、domain（完整域: Changes are saved automatically. Kinds: geosite, suffix (domain), domain (full domain), keyword, regex, geoip, cidr (IP range), package (Android app); rule sets can also use url (rule-set URL).
活动页会用这个名称显示命中这条规则的连接: The activity page shows this name for connections that matched the rule
搜索名称、代码或简拼，例如 rb: Search name, code or pinyin initials, e.g. rb
路由模式、路由路径、规则集、分组代理: Routing mode, route, rule sets, policy groups
所有应用，或只代理 / 排除选中的应用: All apps, or only / all but the selected ones
选中的服务会整组加入，包含它们的全部域名: A service is added as a whole, with all of its domains
整组加入，不用自己找域名: Added as a whole, no need to look up domains
选中的应用发起的连接都走这里: Every connection the selected apps make goes here
分组代理是一组节点（比如所有日本节点），可以自动选最快的，也可以手动选一个。建好: A policy group is a set of nodes (all Japanese nodes, say) that uses the fastest one or the one you choose. Once created, pick it as a rule's target, for example to send YouTube through Japan.
用远程 DNS 经代理解析，不会被污染；部分国内 CDN 网站可能被当成境外而走: Resolved with the remote DNS through the proxy, which is never tampered with; some sites on Chinese CDNs may be taken for foreign ones and go through the proxy.
用直连 DNS 解析，能认出国内 CDN 网站；已知的境外网站不解析，直接按域名: Resolved with the direct DNS, which recognises sites on Chinese CDNs; known foreign sites are not resolved and go through the proxy by name.
DNS、代理范围、通知等: DNS, proxied apps, notifications and more
全部，包括代理范围: All of them, proxied apps included
一组节点（比如所有日本节点），自动用最快的或由你选一个。在规则的「走哪里」里选它: A set of nodes (all Japanese nodes, say) that uses the fastest one or the one you pick. Choose it as a rule's target, for example to send YouTube through Japan.
经代理用远程 DNS 解析，不会被污染: Resolved with the remote DNS through the proxy; never tampered with
能认出国内 CDN，被封锁的网站可能解析出错: Recognises Chinese CDNs; blocked sites may be resolved wrongly
直连 DNS 会把一些被封锁的网站解析成错误的地址，代理随后连到这些地址，表现为: The direct DNS answers some blocked sites with wrong addresses, and the proxy is then sent to those: connected, but pages do not open. Known foreign sites are not affected, less known ones can be. Use it only when mainland sites are taken for foreign ones and must go direct.
用直连 DNS 解析，能认出国内 CDN 网站；但被封锁的网站可能拿到错误的地址: Resolved with the direct DNS, which recognises sites on Chinese CDNs; blocked sites may get wrong addresses and then do not open.
指定的域名改用别的 DNS 服务器解析，或者直接指定 IP: Chosen domains are answered by another DNS server or get fixed IPs
优先于远程 / 直连 DNS。机场提供的解锁 DNS 一般需要「经代理查询」。: Used before the remote / direct DNS. The unlocking DNS of a provider usually needs “Ask through the proxy”.
下次直接测速，可在设置 → 测速里修改: Test right away next time; change it in Settings → Test
%d 条规则，按去向分成 %d 个规则集；能转换 %d 条: %d rules into %d rule sets by target; %d can be converted
%d 条规则无法转换，导入时会跳过: %d rules cannot be converted and are skipped
按订阅里的配置，只用于它的节点: Taken from the subscription, only for its nodes
添加或更新订阅时会自动识别。只用于这个订阅的节点，不影响其他订阅。: Found when a subscription is added or updated. Used only for its nodes; other subscriptions are not affected.
无法访问测速地址，点击重试: Test address not reachable, tap to retry
落地检测失败，点击重试: Exit check failed, tap to retry
只影响既不在国内网站名单、也不在境外网站名单里的网站: Only for sites on neither the mainland China list nor the foreign list
被封锁的网站可能拿到错误的地址，表现为已连接却打不开网页。只有国内网站被误判走代: Blocked sites may get wrong addresses: connected, yet pages do not open. Use it only when Chinese sites are wrongly sent through the proxy and must go direct.
添加后马上下载节点，之后按设置自动更新。: The nodes are downloaded right away, then updated as set in Settings.
要看连接来自哪个应用：设置 → 高级 →「显示连接所属应用」。: To see which app made a connection: Settings → Advanced → “Show the app of each connection”.
指定域名改用别的 DNS 或固定 IP: Chosen domains use another DNS or fixed IPs
可以在「设置 → 测速」里改: Can be changed in Settings → Speed test
恢复成订阅里的顺序: Back to the order of the subscription
订阅附带的分组和规则: Groups and rules of the subscription
节点总以订阅为准。勾选的部分转换成 NextBox 自己的设置，以后随订阅更新；: The nodes always follow the subscription. The ticked parts become NextBox settings and follow every update; you can choose again from the group's menu.
能转换 %d / %d 条，分成 %d 个规则集: %d of %d can be converted, into %d rule sets
正在添加订阅，下载完成后自动切换过去: Adding the subscription; it opens when the download is done
添加的先后: The order they were added in
也可以长按节点拖动排序: You can also long-press a node and drag it
“%s”和其中的节点都会被删除。: “%s” and its nodes will be deleted.
有 %d 条规则用到它，删除后改走首页选中的节点。: %d rules use it; after deleting, they use the node selected on Home.
直连 DNS 可能把被封锁的网站解析成错误的地址，表现为已连接却打不开网页（已知: The direct DNS may give blocked sites wrong addresses: connected, yet pages do not open (known foreign sites are not affected). Use it only when Chinese sites are wrongly sent through the proxy and must go direct.
# ads 是屏蔽广告的位置，scene:cn 是「绕过中国大陆」的位置，可以上: # ads is the place of ad blocking, scene:cn that of “Bypass mainland China”; both can be moved
把域名、IP、应用、网站分类等放进同一个规则集，命中其中任何一项都走同一个去向。: Put domains, IPs, apps, site categories and more into one rule set: whatever matches goes to one target. The Activity page shows the name of the rule set that matched.
输入后按回车或「+」加入，可以一次粘贴多个，用换行、逗号或空格分隔。格式不对的值: Type a value and press Enter or “+”. You can paste several at once, separated by new lines, commas or spaces. Values in the wrong format are not saved.
支持 sing-box 的 .srs、.json 规则集和 Clash 规则源（: sing-box rule-sets (.srs, .json) and Clash rule providers (YAML or text, not mrs). Downloaded when connecting and again with “Update rule sets”.
全局代理：除了局域网和屏蔽广告，所有流量都走当前节点，下面的步骤暂不生效。: Global: apart from LAN and ad blocking, all traffic uses the current node; the steps below do not apply for now.
全部直连：不使用代理，下面的步骤暂不生效。: All direct: no proxy; the steps below do not apply for now.
关闭的步骤不显示: Steps that are off are not shown
会删除你添加的所有规则和规则集，步骤顺序恢复成刚安装时的样子，并开启「绕过中国大: Deletes all the rules and rule sets you added, puts the steps back in their first order and turns on “Bypass mainland China”. The routing mode, ad blocking and policy groups stay.
当前节点不通时，换成最快的可用节点: If the node is down, use the fastest working one
点连接时如果当前节点连不上，就从下面选的范围里测出最快的可用节点并换过去。默认关: When connecting and the current node does not work, the fastest working node of the range chosen below is found and used instead. Off by default.
亮屏时每 5 分钟检查一次: Checked every 5 minutes with the screen on
连接后，亮屏时每 5 分钟测一次正在用的节点；连续两次不通才换，一次网络波动不会: While connected and the screen is on, the node in use is tested every 5 minutes; it is replaced after two failures in a row, so a single hiccup does not switch.
测试整个分组前问一次: Ask before testing a whole group
打开网页更快，省一次 DNS 查询: Faster page loads, one DNS query less
走代理的域名立即得到一个虚拟地址，真实地址由代理那边解析，省去一次经代理的 DN: Proxied domains get a placeholder address at once and the proxy resolves the real one, saving a DNS query through the proxy.
仅代理模式，或打开「允许局域网连接」时开启。VPN 模式下手机上的应用不需要它。: Open in proxy-only mode, or with “Allow LAN connections” on. In VPN mode the apps on the phone do not need it.
其他设备可以用这台手机的代理端口: Other devices can use this phone's proxy port
在「活动」页显示，略增耗电: Shown on the Activity page, uses a little more battery
「活动」页显示每个连接是哪个应用发起的。每个连接都要向系统多查询一次，所以会略增: The Activity page shows which app made each connection. Each connection takes one more query to the system, so it uses a little more battery.
基于 sing-box 内核的代理客户端: A proxy client powered by sing-box
电脑上打开的「%s」会变成同名规则集，放在原来的位置。: “%s”, on in the desktop app, becomes a rule set of the same name in the same place.
所有应用经过 NextBox，按规则分流: All apps go through NextBox, routed by the rules
只开本地代理端口，由应用自己设置: Only the local proxy port; apps set it themselves
